text:
maria.docs: Hey team — PR ready: migrating the Rate limits & Quotas doc to the new metering SDK examples. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4234  :party-parrot:
cheng: Taking a look. Quick flag — the Grafana panel UUID in the docs is stale; live dashboard moved under /d/usage-metrics. I'll paste the new panel link and export JSON shortly.
samir: We also need an updated SDK snippet for Node showing header-based quota usage. Current example references the old `X-Rate-Limit` header. New flow uses `x-rw-metering` and `metering.unit`. Can add a compact example?
olivia: Also add a migration note about burst credits: behavior changed to per-route bursts that decay over ~1h (not per-minute). Call this out in the tiers section and the burst FAQs. :lock:
maria.docs: Thanks. Samir — could you drop a 3-line Node snippet (minimal) so people can copy it into the examples section?
samir: Sure, draft below:
```js
const res = await client.request('POST', '/v1/generate', {
  headers: { 'x-rw-metering': 'usage=100;unit=tokens' },
  json: { model: 'rw-base', input: '...' }
});
console.log(res.headers['x-rw-remaining']);
```
cheng: That looks good. For the dashboard link, replace the old URL `https://grafana.redwood.local/panel/old123` with `https://grafana.redwood.local/d/usage-metrics/rates-and-quotas?orgId=1&panelId=42` and update the widget name to `rate_consume_by_tier`. I'll verify the panel export after you push.
docs-bot: Preview deployed to staging: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits?pr=4234 :eyes:
olivia: Can we also add a tiny bullet list for tier thresholds in the pricing/tiers section? Suggestion:
- Free: 5,000 tokens/day
- Pro: 1,000,000 tokens/day + 10 req/s burst
- Enterprise: custom commit and SLA
maria.docs: I'll incorporate Samir's snippet, Cheng's panel link, and Olivia's tier bullets. I'll add a "Burst credits and decay" migration blurb and a short note about updating alerting to use `rate_consume_by_tier`.
samir: One more, add a Python one-liner for quick migration docs:
```py
resp = client.generate(..., headers={'x-rw-metering': 'usage=250;unit=tokens'})
print(resp.headers.get('x-rw-remaining'))
```
maria.docs: Perfect. I'm pushing an update in ~30m. If no objections I'll merge after CI passes. :thumbsup:
cheng: No objections from infra; I'll run the Grafana export and confirm panel IDs post-merge.
olivia: lgtm from content. Thanks everyone!
